description: This file exports various functions, types, and modules related to WhatsApp text runtime operations, acting as an index or aggregation point for related functionalities.

methods.name: assertWebChannel
methods.description: Checks or asserts the presence of a web channel, likely used for communication or message handling.

methods.name: isSelfChatMode
methods.description: Determines if the current chat mode is a self-chat mode.

methods.name: jidToE164
methods.description: Converts a JID (Jabber ID) to E.164 phone number format.

methods.name: markdownToWhatsApp
methods.description: Converts markdown formatted text into a WhatsApp-compatible format.

methods.name: resolveJidToE164
methods.description: Resolves a given JID to its E.164 phone number equivalent.

methods.name: toWhatsappJid
methods.description: Converts or formats a identifier into WhatsApp JID format.
